description: Menjelaskan satu kode wilayah: nama, jenis, semua induknya dan jumlah wilayah di bawahnya. Returns the name, kind, all parents (province down) and child count of a Kemendagri region code. Accepts 31.71.03.1001 or 3171031001. Level-4 codes are also the BMKG "adm4" codes. Offline, free.
name: detail_kode
title: Detail kode wilayah / Code details
